Maria (CS): FYI Silverline reported a 2x bump in p95/p99 over the last 48h and called out inference cost as a renewal concern. They’re on redwood-standard-large, ~20 req/s avg, bursts to 80. Can we propose low-risk perf recs to avoid churn?
Jun (SE): thanks — can you paste a recent trace or sample logs? curious if this is queueing vs model compute.
Maria (CS): pasted trace excerpt below from their shared diagnostic bundle (timestamps redacted).
Maria (CS): ```
request_id: abc123
model: redwood-standard-large
latency_ms: p50=45 p95=310 p99=980
queue_ms: p50=5 p95=60 p99=520
tokens: avg_in=64 avg_out=128
errors: none
```
Jun (SE): looks like tail latency is compute heavy but also some queueing at peak. quick wins: 1) try int4 aggressive compression profile for that model (bench first on canary) 2) route latency-critical routes to the dedicated low-latency pool + enable KV prefix caching 3) spin up a 5-10% canary to redwood-compact-v2 (lower FLOPs) and run eval set.
Rafael (SolutionsEng): +1. For routing, we can add a weighted policy: prefer dedicated-pool for requests with header `x-sla: p99` then fallback to compact model when capacity constrained. I'll sketch rollout YAML.
Rafael (SolutionsEng): ```yaml
rollout:
  target: service/silverline-api
  strategy: canary
  phases:
    - pct: 10
      model: redwood-compact-v2
      duration: 72h
    - pct: 100
      model: redwood-compact-v2
      metric: p99_latency
      threshold: 350ms
routing: 
  policy: prefer
  prefer: dedicated-low-latency
  fallback: redwood-compact-v2
```
Anjali (AE): Customer is sensitive to any accuracy regressions — Emma asked we measure hallucination + top-level intent accuracy against their 1k eval set. Also renewal convo next week, so timeline = tight. Recommend canary + parallel evals and a short joint review with Silverline.
Jun (SE): understood. I'll run the int4 quant bench on a replica, compare logits/ROUGE on their evals, and surface delta. If accuracy drop <2% we can go ahead.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary job created by Jun (SE) for silverline-canary-2147483600 — status: queued. :gear:
Maria (CS): great — plan: (1) Jun runs quant bench + start 10% canary (2) Rafael implements routing policy with dedicated preference + fallback (3) Anjali schedules a 30-min review with Silverline and shares eval criteria. I'll own customer comms.
Anjali (AE): I'll book the review and note renewal stakes.
Rafael (SolutionsEng): I'll drop the routing PR and a traffic-shift playbook in the workspace by EOD.
Jun (SE): will post bench results and eval deltas here when complete.
Maria (CS): thanks team — trying to avoid an escalation. :pray:
